result.title: Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Sets for Incomplete Data
result.summary: Attribute reduction in incomplete information systems is difficult because missing values break the equivalence-class structure of rough set theory. We propose the Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Set (COFRS) model. Each object is described by its set of present attributes. The similarity of two objects is a weighted overlap on the attributes present in both, divided by the fixed number of attributes |A| instead of the size of their union, so missing values are penalised globally and are not matched as wildcards. From this similarity we define a soft dependency degree based on weighted granule consistency, and we search for reducts by greedy backward elimination in O(|U|^2 |A|^2) time. We show that the relation is symmetric and non-reflexive, that the dependency degree is not monotone, and we give a sufficient condition under which monotonicity holds. On 11 UCI benchmarks with missing rates from 0.15% to 20.46%, COFRS gives the smallest reducts on average (4.1 attributes, against 5.0-11.2 for Tolerance-RS, a range-threshold variant Tol-RS_tau, Zhou-RS and the min-aggregation variant COFRS-min). The difference is significant against Tol-RS_tau, Zhou-RS and COFRS-min (Holm-adjusted Wilcoxon p<0.01) but not against Tolerance-RS (p=0.56), and it is small against the Jensen-Shen selector (adjusted p=0.084). At equal reduct size, COFRS selects more informative attributes than random subsets. With a kNN classifier the methods do not differ significantly in accuracy, F1 or G-mean; with an RBF-SVM they do, and COFRS ranks last. The gain is therefore compactness, not predictive accuracy.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Set（COFRS），针对不完整信息系统，用仅在共同出现属性上计算的加权重叠相似度（分母固定为 |A|，使缺失被整体惩罚）定义基于加权粒度一致性的软依赖度，并以贪心后向消减搜索约简，在 11 个 UCI 缺失数据基准上比较约简规模与 kNN、RBF-SVM 预测表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「缺失即惩罚」的部分观测相似度与按属性子集评估信息量的软依赖度，可能为证据不全时潜在状态相似度度量与视觉证据筛选提供远领域线索，但联系较间接，可供核查。
